title: A case run against onboarding's placeholder serve fails, naming the placeholder
description: In a fixture repository onboarded with no application, so onboarding wrote its placeholder e2e.serve, an HTTP case the merge trial runs fails with a reason naming the placeholder serve, and master status carries the placeholder line; once the repository declares a real serve command, the same case runs against it and passes and the line is gone.

steps.name: the placeholder serve fails a case, then a declared serve passes it
